title: Games resume after the DTRA contract ends: an SF86 request puts his clearance in 'undefined'

tellings.quote: And this just happened to me in contact in the desert. I was using my security clearance last June.

plain: Dylan Borland, a man who says he held a US security clearance, says that once his contract with DTRA, a Pentagon agency that deals with weapons of mass destruction, ended in 2024 or 2025, the "games" against him started again. He tells Michels he was still using his clearance "last June," but a request to file a new SF86, the standard form for a government background check, left his clearance listed as "undefined." He tells it as a sign that someone is quietly getting in his way.
